source.title: On List Coloring and List Homomorphism of Permutation and Interval Graphs
source.authoritative_claim: Polynomial-time List Coloring on permutation graphs when the total number of colors is bounded.
source.application_here: The X_k carrier uses total palette [4], hence a fixed bounded total number of colors.

graph_class_bridge.claim: Chain graphs are a subclass of bipartite permutation graphs, hence permutation graphs.
graph_class_bridge.application_here: The nonfixed X_k core H, and every active induced subgraph after forcing/deletion, is a chain graph and therefore lies in the source algorithm's graph class.

constructive_wrapper.decision_to_witness: Use standard self-reduction. For each active vertex v, try each color c in its current list (at most four), set L(v)={c}, and retain the first choice for which the decision backend remains YES.
constructive_wrapper.decision_calls: At most 4n backend calls plus polynomial bookkeeping.
constructive_wrapper.effect: Provides exact reconstruction witness in polynomial time without assuming the published algorithm itself directly outputs a coloring.

firewalls: The theorem is used only on permutation/chain graph instances with fixed total palette [4].
No generic P7 List-4 solver is inferred.
No generic precoloring-extension solver is inferred.
The result closes only the declared X_k structural carrier.
